decisions.decision: Replaced LPT+atomic with cyclic partition scheduling
decisions.rationale: Fibonacci hash distributes partitions uniformly → cyclic gives equivalent load balance with zero atomic/sort overhead

decisions.decision: FlatCountMap slot hash = key & mask (identity), NOT Fibonacci
decisions.rationale: Fibonacci hash 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15 is correlated with partitioning hash 0x9E3779B9. All keys in a partition cluster into the same 128-slot range causing infinite-length probing. Identity hash is uncorrelated and distributes uniformly.
Colleague uses 5M base — larger workload makes PAR(t=1) overhead <4% instead of 14%, showing monotone WSE curve for comparison
